title: Spreading one stalk-linear map from a finitely presented source
statement: Let $(X,\mathcal O_X)$ be a ringed space, $\mathcal F$ a finitely presented module sheaf [def-weil-pbc-module-finite-type-presentation], $\mathcal G$ any module sheaf and $x\in X$. Given an $\mathcal O_{X,x}$-linear map $\chi:\mathcal F_x\to\mathcal G_x$ of module stalks [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk], [def-pc-module-stalk-functor], there exist an open $U\ni x$ and a local morphism $\varphi\in\mathcal Hom(\mathcal F,\mathcal G)(U)$ [def-pur-sheaf-hom] such that for every open $V\subseteq U$ containing $x$ and every $s\in\mathcal F(V)$, $(\varphi_V(s))_x=\chi(s_x)$. No uniqueness, injectivity, or stalk comparison equivalence is asserted.

source.place: Tag 01CP, proof, third paragraph: finite-coordinate kernel lifting, expanded using representatives and the presentation cokernel.

proof.text: Choose a finite local presentation using IsFinitePresentation.exists_quasicoherentData and Opens.coversTop_iff. Its generators and relations give a,b with a composed with b zero and P.isColimit. Lift chi after b on a smaller open by finite free local stalk map lifting.

The germ formula for the lifted map applied to a relation is chi of the germ of b(a(t)); a composed with b is zero, so all these germs vanish. Apply finite free local hom zero to shrink and kill the relation morphism. Restriction preserves the presentation cokernel. Descend the generator map using CokernelCofork.IsColimit.desc'.

Apply local stalk factorization germ comparison to the epimorphism b, its lifted map psi, the already constructed descent theta and its cokernel factorization equation. This gives the internal-Hom section and its formula on every subneighborhood.

proof_origin.place: Tag 01CP, lemma-stalk-internal-hom, third paragraph; read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01CP
proof_origin.note: Finite-coordinate lifting split into two finite free steps. The local epimorphism germ lift and comparison of the constructed factorization are proved without sorry. The item proves finite-presentation selection, relation germ vanishing, restriction of the cokernel and descent; only the two finite free statements remain open.

mathlib_searches.results: Mathlib has module stalk actions and local finite presentation data, but no internal-Hom stalk theorem. Library has StalkInternalHomEvaluation and the parent FinitePresentationStalkKernel. StalkInternalHomFinitePresentation imports the parent and cannot be used here. Existing 01CP nodes concern the whole comparison, scheme Hom kernels, or coherent stalk maps, not this intermediate assertion.

lean.statement: theorem exists_local_internalHom_of_stalkLinearMap (X : RingedSpace.{u}) (F G : SheafOfModules.{u} ((sheafCompose (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj X.sheaf)) [SheafOfModules.IsFinitePresentation.{u} F] (x : X) (χ : (moduleStalkFunctor X x).obj F →ₗ[X.presheaf.stalk x] (moduleStalkFunctor X x).obj G) : ∃ (U : Opens X) (hxU : x ∈ U) (φ : (F.homObj G).val.obj (op U)), ∀ (V : Opens X) (i : V ⟶ U) (hxV : x ∈ V) (s : F.val.obj (op V)), TopCat.Presheaf.germ G.val.presheaf V x hxV (φ.app (op (Over.mk i)) s) = χ (TopCat.Presheaf.germ F.val.presheaf V x hxV s)
